steps.caption: A linked location
steps.chapter: Its own tab on every listing
steps.narration: Profile Guard watches a linked listing for edits. Every location has its own tab for it.

steps.caption: Profile Guard
steps.narration: Open the location and choose Profile Guard.

steps.caption: Current mode, last check
steps.narration: The current mode and the last check, for this listing only.

steps.caption: Off, Notify, Lockdown
steps.narration: Mode: Off, Notify, or Lockdown, which puts your approved value back after a change.

steps.caption: Watched fields
steps.narration: Watched fields are the parts of the listing it compares.

steps.caption: Owner-approved snapshot
steps.narration: The owner-approved snapshot is the version it compares Google against.

steps.caption: Confirm it's you
steps.narration: Saving asks you to confirm it's you, so a signed-in session can't quietly turn it off.

steps.caption: Pending changes and history
steps.narration: Pending changes and history lists what changed on this listing.

steps.caption: Approved vs detected
steps.narration: Each one shows the approved value, the detected value, and when it was found.

steps.caption: Approve or Reject
steps.narration: Approve accepts Google's new value; Reject restores yours.

steps.caption: Right next to the listing
steps.narration: So edit alerts sit right next to the listing's details, services and photos.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find Profile Guard on each location | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: Every linked location in ConstructHUB has its own Profile Guard tab, so edit alerts sit next to the listing they watch. The tab shows the current mode and last check, the mode (Off, Notify or Lockdown), the watched fields, the owner-approved snapshot, and Pending changes and history with Approve and Reject for each detected edit.
